style: Live-action Shanghai location photography, natural light and expressions, fine film texture. Fictional scenes and people.

compositions.study: Use the actor’s expression to carry the moment.
Frame backgrounds as an ordinary, physically plausible live-action location.

scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/cover-lilong: Wide horizontal 3:2 original key art for an interactive Shanghai life game, a frame of true-to-life contemporary live action location filmmaking with human warmth. Handheld 35mm camera at sidewalk height from inside the threshold of an old lilong on the former French Concession side of Shanghai at 8:20am in late spring. Left 38% in naturally deep soft shade, a weathered dark green wooden door and old textured masonry, calm and mostly empty for the title overlay. Right two thirds open to fresh morning sunlight. At x=73% y=37% for their heads, two fictional East Asian young adults early 20s in everyday summer clothes, one woman with a faded blue shirt and a small tomato red soft canvas shoulder bag, and one man in a beige open overshirt, both in profile, are turning toward a friendly middle-aged breakfast shop owner who is handing them a white paper bag; their one scratched moss-green carry-on beside them lower in frame. A parked bicycle cropped at edge, ordinary neighboring residents and hanging laundry far deeper in the courtyard. Rows of traditional Shanghai red brick shikumen row houses, carved pale lintels, stone stoop, narrow courtyard, overhead plane tree leaves lit by the sun. The characters casually smile during the exchange without looking at camera, natural teeth and hands, unstaged real skin, unposed documentary photograph, subtle 35mm film texture, fresh natural green and warm masonry red with normal daylight white balance, middle contrast, natural shadows, good highlight latitude. Natural lived-in neighborhood without excessive clutter. Real scale, few subjects. Keep the interaction separated from the doorway and all major faces around the upper-right-middle, compose to also permit tall crop of right side. No stylized illustration, CGI, skin smoothing, fog, color cast, teal-orange grading, beauty ad, movie poster layout, neon, readable lettering, graphic design, or border.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/bund.webp: Landscape 3:2 exceptionally realistic and naturally attractive location still for an interactive contemporary Shanghai game. Standing on the granite Bund promenade on an ordinary breezy spring late afternoon, eye-level 35 mm real optics, accurately depict a wide Huangpu River, the Oriental Pearl with its characteristic red spheres left of the Pudong cluster and the twisted Shanghai Tower on the right, realistic distant scale and spacing, working ferry on the river mid-distance. Foreground one unposed grey-haired local in a mid blue cotton shirt halfway turned to speak to a friend in a sun-faded rust cap. On the far left a short glimpse of the real Bund waterfront and pale early 20th-century historic stone architecture at appropriate distance. Frame from the side, people occupy less than 22% of image, candid documentary photography with pale warm late sunlight and natural cloud movement, natural color, subdued blue and green but clear whites, fresh soft air, nuanced shadows, authentic skin and concrete, normal city clothing. Compose skyline and river for a center crop. No special effects, sunset fire, tourist promo saturation, synthetic gloss, painterly shapes, added text or signage, logo or border.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/anfu.webp: Landscape 3:2 very realistic location shot on actual Anfu Road in Xuhui Shanghai in late spring, street-level 35mm cinematic observational photograph under leafy plane trees. Eye-height view down the narrow leafy street, softly mottled sun and clear daytime exposure, genuine small shop fronts recessed in old low brick-and-plaster houses and pre-war apartment entrances. An older Chinese woman in a cream cotton jacket swings open a worn dark green wooden door on left, a cyclist in a washed blue shirt rolling slowly mid-frame, two people queuing at a little independent takeaway in mid-ground, pedestrians on the sidewalk. No landmarks from other streets. Distinct but quiet local color: touches of enamel green, pale brick, bicycle red, naturally warm complex skin and green leaf shadows. Observe genuine Shanghai traffic and plausible architecture, candid adult faces and believable limbs, no legible lettering, no brand names, no hyper-real HDR, fog, glamorous lighting, airbrushing, neon, illustration, poster layout, or border. Framing with people in middle third but natural breathing room.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/people.webp: Landscape 3:2 unposed true photographic street scene of Shanghai People's Park matchmaking corner on a bright spring weekend, seen while stepping onto a path. Low side-angle observer under a green plane tree, real paved path and mature trees, a few older Chinese adults actively gesturing and chatting with each other under one ochre and one dull blue umbrella with little clipped pale paper notices (blank or illegible, at a distance). A retired mother in indigo unselfconsciously laughing with another parent while tapping an umbrella canopy. A scooter helmet resting on a folded portable stool in the foreground edge, no other props crowding the frame. Natural late morning light filtering through leaves, rich lived-in texture, true daylight skin tones, restrained realistic colors with natural separation, real dimensional falloff and moderate depth of field, not tourism advertising. 40mm eye-level lens. Important moment in middle of image for game crops. No fashion pose, suspiciously perfect smiles, painting, illustration, CGI, night fog, soft focus, color grading, readable writing, subtitles, or border.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/cover-parall: One original wide 3:2 still for the second game mode of a contemporary Shanghai life-simulation, looks like a live-action quiet urban film photograph. At a real Shanghai Metro overground station late in a spring afternoon, a young Chinese woman age 25 in a simple tobacco cotton jacket and cream shoulder bag just got on a train. Camera stands in a natural position on platform and observes her through window on the RIGHT half at x=72%, y=40%; her palm rests casually on the rail just below the window, she is looking out slightly to the right, lips relaxed as if deciding whether to get back off. Natural soft warm side sun, honest skin texture, soft believable window reflection of the platform trees and apartment blocks, no duplicate face, realistic proportions, believable distance from the camera. Warm pale silver train body, dark oxide red narrow exterior belt line, doors and windows follow one perspective. The leftmost 44% is the under-canopy shaded side of the platform and train in perspective with dark textures and fairly restrained contrast for UI; include a couple of distant unposed passengers for scale. City apartment blocks and leaves vaguely visible beyond, little fine grain. In the right-center cropping safe for portrait phone display. No illustration, AI sheen, smooth CGI, uncanny extra person, readable letters, logos, graphics, distorted train, color cast or borders.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/lujiazui.web: Original 3:2 landscape photographic in-game district establishing frame. Genuine Lujiazui financial district from street level at the end of an ordinary spring workday, looking along a real pedestrian concourse under a believable elevated circular pedestrian walkway and structural columns. Down the road real layered glass office towers and the recognizable Shanghai World Financial Center with correct rectangular opening high above and its realistic relative distance. A pair of young Chinese colleagues with normal work bags are in mid-ground by a pillar, one takes the takeout iced coffee from the other, commuters dispersed farther away. One ordinary cab passing, clean low afternoon sun glancing along brushed metal, believable neutral skin tones, pale blue, concrete and subtle warm greys, human scale, candid local film with true 35mm optics, clear shadows and no Instagram grade. Center crop safe, room at bottom for game UI. No fake lettering, logos, CGI, painted detail, invented towers, telephoto distortion, megacity fantasy, poster, framing, or subtitles.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/zhangjiang.w: Original 3:2 landscape naturally photorealistic in-game district establishing still for contemporary Shanghai. Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park at around 5:30 pm, true Shanghai suburban technology campus, medium-sized cream concrete and glass R&D office buildings around an outdoor campus entry, tidy row of believable parked common electric scooters and bicycles, silver card turnstiles, curb and green trees. A few adults naturally leaving work including a woman in a dusty blue cotton shirt and black work backpack fastening her bicycle lock while a coworker checks the bus time. No posing or looking at camera. Slightly lateral 40mm eye-level documentary composition, fresh lime green leaves with real late-day warm light on face and hand, strong sense of normal weekday life, realistic skin and masonry. Center crop safe, natural negative space near bottom. No high-rise skyline, startup stock photo, screen text, graphic overlays, fake labels, illustration, CGI, or oversaturation.
scenes.public/art/shanghai-streets/xinzhuang.we: Original 3:2 landscape location still for a live-action Shanghai narrative game. Authentic Xinzhuang district, Minhang Shanghai; ordinary late-1990s six-storey walk-up with warm beige ceramic tile walls and external air conditioner units, ground-floor entrance with shallow dark burgundy canopy, a sheltered cluster of bikes, open utility boxes, mature neighborhood trees. Early evening with natural warm light reflecting off opposite building and last cool daylight in shadows. At middle right, a middle aged resident in an ordinary red and cream striped tee steps around an elderly neighbor pushing a small grocery trolley with leafy vegetables; they recognize each other. Natural real proportions and candid gesture; street observed from three meters away from the walkway at eye height with 40mm optics, quiet offhand beauty, natural colors and realistic uncluttered depth. Leave lower foreground available for label and composition middle third crop-safe. No advertising, no pretty old town, no ancient Chinese architectural decorations, no illustration, CG, overly nostalgic brown cast, fake letters, graphic design, or border.

portraitReference.instruction: Use the matching fictional character’s portrait as the reference for identity and wardrobe.

portraitSharedPrompt: Identity-preserving edit of the supplied fictional game character only. Create an original 2:3 vertical mid-thigh portrait for a Shanghai narrative game, like a single unposed frame of a contemporary live-action ensemble film. Use a realistic normal 50 mm lens at human eye height, head centered horizontally and eyes centered at approximately 27 percent down, visible top of hair, torso visible below. Camera about two meters away, enough space around face for versatile crops. Real skin including pores and minute blemishes, retain age and facial structure, hair and key costume of reference. Clothes are real cotton or silk with natural creasing, with soft ordinary practical light and real imperfect lived-in details in the moderately soft background. A glimpse of genuine spontaneous emotion, no eye contact with camera, moderate contrast, accurate color, never grey monochrome. No cartoon, no CGI, no smoothing, no editorial studio gloss, no fantasy blur, no added writing, border or graphic overlay.

public/art/portraits/player-female-every.prompt: Fictional 22-year-old Chinese woman in the reference, same softly square oval face, small under-eye folds, dark hair loosely tied with face-framing flyaways, same navy work jacket and cream cloth bag. Has just paused to check the number on a Shanghai lane house doorway, her body about to move again, looks slightly up and to the camera's right with a tiny look of recognition, not toward the lens. Indirect morning light from the courtyard, sage enamel mailbox and old muted maroon door behind, useful blue/cream palette, natural expression.

public/art/portraits/player-female-charm.prompt: Fictional 23-year-old Chinese woman in the reference, same soft cheek line and dark chin-length wavy bob with an irregular fringe, brick-red overshirt sleeves rolled over white cotton crewneck, natural and radiant. Waiting at the hatch of a neighborhood bakery, eyes lowered slightly in three-quarter view as an offscreen baker has just made her laugh; nose wrinkles very slightly, teeth realistic, wind catches loose hair. A worn oak window ledge and dim stainless shelves softly blurred, sunny side bounce through the window.

public/art/portraits/player-female-stunn.prompt: Fictional 25-year-old Chinese woman in the reference. Keep her face exactly recognizable, same distinctive lifted eyes, dark hair swept and tied, long nose bridge, small gold hoops, dark emerald green form-fitting silk qipao dress, wearing it with poised understated glamour and quiet sensuality. She is at a quietly elegant Shanghai apartment staircase in warm late-day window light, having just turned her eyes toward the other person arriving, in three-quarter view with a small knowing smile. A light strand has fallen at her temple. The fabric has a plausible silk weave, real seam and gentle natural folds. Old terrazzo staircase and warm ivory wall give context.

public/art/portraits/player-male-everyda.prompt: Fictional 23-year-old Chinese man in the reference, same short crew cut, straight brows and familiar jaw, same practical workwear grey jacket and black cross-body strap. At a Shanghai bus stop in soft bright overcast daylight, his head at a slight angle to the left as he talks to someone offscreen, real faint smile and a little stubble, shoulder still tilted as he adjusts his strap below the chest. Gently blurred blue and white transit shelter, normal spring greens behind, soft facial shadow.

public/art/portraits/player-male-charmin.prompt: Fictional 24-year-old Chinese man in the reference, same round wire glasses, swept slightly curly dark hair, distinctive cheeks and warm smile, oatmeal knit cardigan over white T-shirt, canvas bag. Friendly slight smile, one cheek lifts more than the other, daylight brushes the frames but his eyes remain visible. Warm unpolished wood and books softly blurred behind, ordinary daylight.

public/art/portraits/player-male-stunnin.prompt: Fictional 25-year-old Chinese man in the reference, keep same angular cheekbones, dark centre parted windswept hair, tall slim build and deep plum jacket over ivory cotton shirt. Outside a lived-in Shanghai street-corner barbershop in clear late-afternoon bounce light, in the middle of glancing over his shoulder at someone who called his name; quiet confident half-smile, an old shop towel and soft wall reflections far behind him, textured plum jacket with real folds. Natural elegance in an ordinary street, no fashion-catalogue pose.
